issues.description: The REST endpoint method createPerson in PersonResource has different return types in the template and the solution. The template declares createPerson to return ResponseEntity<Person> while the solution declares it as void. This mismatch is structural (method signature difference) and may confuse students comparing the provided template and the reference solution or when following examples/documentation that assume a specific return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature between template and solution. Either change the solution's createPerson to return ResponseEntity<Person> (and return the saved person as ResponseEntity.ok(...)) or change the template to use void (and document that the endpoint returns HTTP 200 with no body). Update any examples/tests or documentation to reflect the chosen signature so students have a single consistent reference.
